description: This file defines template classes for managing web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, within a Web namespace. It includes classes for handling transfer states, link management, request/response processing, hash calculation, and authorization mechanisms, primarily for file uploads and downloads over web protocols.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a singleton element of type ELEMENT, providing access via the Element() method.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including state management, request handling, hash calculation, and transfer control for upload and download of files.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests, file storage, authorization, and response generation for file uploads and retrievals.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a local destination.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to set up connection parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when transfer is complete.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize incoming requests.
